title: fix: auto top-up double credit on concurrent invoice webhooks
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Both `invoice.paid` and `invoice.payment_succeeded` call `creditAutoTopUpInvoice`, so every auto top-up invoice gets two near-simultaneous credit calls. The wallet update only checked for a paid attempt with `completed_at = now`. If both calls computed the same millisecond, the second batch's attempt update changed nothing, but its wallet update still matched, and the pack was credited twice.

- The batch now credits the wallet only while the attempt is still `pending`/`failed`, then marks it paid in the same transaction. A concurrent caller then sees `paid` and credits nothing.
- `credited` now comes from the wallet update's changes.
- Adds a regression test: two concurrent calls with a frozen `Date.now` raise `pack_balance` by exactly one pack. It fails on main (balance 21 instead of 11).

gist.headline: One invoice, one refill
gist.blurb: Two Stripe webhook events can arrive for the same auto top-up. The wallet now counts the refill once, even when they turn up at the same millisecond.
gist.summary: Auto top-ups now credit the wallet only while an invoice attempt is pending or failed, then mark it paid in the same transaction, preventing concurrent invoice.paid and invoice.payment_succeeded webhooks from crediting two packs.
gist.impact: A completed auto top-up adds exactly one pack to the wallet, even when both Stripe webhook events arrive simultaneously.
